title: Chrome Glide
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring metallic FM lead in the mid-high register whose FM index and harmonicity swell while a pitch envelope accelerates into each note as a glide. Over 16 cycles the glide steepens and the timbre brightens from hollow to screaming chrome, then resets.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 [c3 eb3] g3 <bb3 f3>>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(3, 13)).fmh("<2 2.5 3.5 1.5>/4")
    .penv(sine.slow(24).range(-7, -22)).pattack(sine.slow(16).range(0.18, 0.02)).pdecay(0.04)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(900, 5200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.12)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.07)
    .shape(0.4).crush("<16 12 8>/8")
    .vib("<5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 1.1))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.25).pan(0.85))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.25).gain(0.85)
)
